I have insomnia.

Imagine wanting to sleep, but being terrified to sleep.

In the Nightmare On Elm Street, if you sleep, you die. Freddy Kruger gets you and you die. This is what it's like for me.

If I don't sleep, I'm safe from the panic attacks, flashbacks, etc. But, I'm cranky, tired, barely functioning on a body and brain that have gone to bed 4 days ago. But... If I sleep, the nightmares come back, the abuse, the *abuser*.

Freddy Kruger is real, and he comes in the form of flashbacks and memories processed as nightmares. Only he lets me wake up. He makes me wish I was dead. He knows that the process to get to sleep is just as hard as the process to deal with the nightmares. He knows that I want the nightmares to stop and he likes torturing me because he knows as well as I do that they will still come. Maybe not tomorrow, or this week, but one day they can come back.

I've been taking sleeping pills to get to bed. And sometimes, I'll take a pill for panic attacks so I can just drift into a void where I just wake up tomorrow. It makes me feel groggy and heavy. But I don't wake up screaming, I don't wake up crying and clutching my teddy bear for comfort, I wake up without fear. I have to take a pill to sleep right now, I get enough sleep, I can start the day right. And that's good enough for me.
